messages.subject: Show app UI in three steps
parts:
I am new to Shiny and have been stuck on a relatively simple issue.

I want to create several apps with the same basic structure. UI is presented in three steps.
1) User asked to upload a file
2) Once uploaded, it is previewed (say first 5 obs)  and user is presented with textbox and action button.
3) User enters a formula in textbox  (e.g, "y~x1+x2") and, upon clicking button, R runs the formula within a model say lm(f), and reports results

I can get Shiny to run all this at once, but not for the questions to be asked sequentially and work properly. I have tried the online guides and they just were not enough for me.

What's the simplest way to do this? (my code has a lot of idiosyncrasies, such as relying on custom stat functions and the Shiny part is very amateurish so am guessing a generinc simple answer for  something along teh lines described above is better than tweaking the code i already have so that it actually works)


Thanks,
Uri
